evidence_scope: Mechanical provenance and consistency; does not test semantic correctness of model interpretations.

checks.rationale: A quoted student endorsement can support a linked option proposition without inventing a student quote.
Rejection cannot support a current misconception.
Uncertainty cannot support a current misconception.
Quotation without endorsement cannot support a current misconception.
Broad compound agreement cannot establish each constituent belief.
A supported proposition cannot be a misconception.
An answer-only observation is not reasoning evidence.
Restating supplied facts alone is not a conceptual misconception.
Adopting a supplied explanation requires its source.
The referenced label must exist in this sealed item.
An existing label must also match its quoted content.
Whitespace is not a source quote.
Option wording cannot be substituted for the student's own words.
A reasoning observation must not be attributed to the tempting field.
A claim must link to the actual supporting interpretation.
A linked claim must preserve the reviewed proposition.
An eligible reviewed error must not vanish from coverage.
One observation must not inflate the misconception count.
Ambiguous observation IDs cannot ground a claim.
New live diagnostics must not silently revert to the old contract.
Non-endorsed propositions remain observations, not deleted evidence.
Non-endorsed propositions remain observations, not deleted evidence.
Non-endorsed propositions remain observations, not deleted evidence.
Stored prior diagnostics remain readable without fabricated stance metadata.
Historical readability is not permission to generate incomplete new records.
Off-topic instructions need not be recast as beliefs about the assessed concept.
The irrelevant exception must not permit supported reasoning without an observation.
A legacy diagnosis must not acquire the current interpretation version.
Options from a different item cannot ground the observation.
A changed option must not validate against the original reference.
The application must not upgrade supplied explanation endorsement to independently precise reasoning.
Teachers/researchers need the distinction even when the answer is correct.
Recognizing a supplied explanation is not strong independent explanatory evidence.
Versioned interpretations survive the persisted-profile JSON contract.
